title: Maximum Meeting Schedule
description: Given meeting intervals, select the maximum number of non-overlapping meetings. A meeting can start exactly when the previous selected meeting ends.
inputFormat: First line: n. Next n lines contain start and end times for each meeting.
outputFormat: Print the maximum number of non-overlapping meetings.
hints: Prefer the meeting that finishes earliest among the currently available choices.

examples.explanation: Every meeting can be selected because adjacent meetings may share an endpoint.
